name: Ahmad Amaan
headline: Software engineer building reliable backend systems and AI applications.
about: I’m a Platform Software Engineer 2 at Oracle and an IIT Kanpur graduate. My work spans distributed workflows, database persistence, APIs, CI/CD, and observability. Outside work, I build applications that turn complex systems and data into tools people can use, from LLM telemetry and application coaching to football simulations. I also co-authored research on uncertainty in neural networks published in IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics.

projects.title: LLM Inference Logging
projects.description: A provider-agnostic TypeScript SDK and dashboard for understanding LLM requests. It captures latency, token usage, errors, and redacted previews, with PostgreSQL-backed event storage and a Redis/BullMQ worker for asynchronous ingestion. A streaming chat interface demonstrates the instrumentation end to end.

projects.title: Applywise — AI Application Coach
projects.description: An AI application coach that turns a candidate’s experience and a job description into an editable preparation plan. It combines contextual chat, resume bullet drafts, interview questions, and checklists, with persistent session state and checkpointed generation workflows.

projects.title: Fuelwise — Fuel Route Planner
projects.description: A Django API that plans US road trips with fuel stops, purchase quantities, cost estimates, and interactive maps. It combines road routing, station identity matching, spatial search, fuel-range validation, caching, and a bounded detour search when the direct route lacks coverage.

projects.title: MerchantPay
projects.description: A merchant payment prototype focused on reliable accounting. A Go API manages idempotent payment intents, verifies finalized Solana devnet transfers, and records balanced ledger entries for reconciliation. A TypeScript checkout provides payment QR codes while signing remains in the user’s external wallet.

projects.title: World Cup 2026 Monte Carlo Predictor
projects.description: A transparent football forecasting model combining Elo-style ratings, attack and defence profiles, squad information, and tournament rules. I ran 100,000 tournament simulations to estimate each team’s chances of progressing and winning, then explained the approach and its limitations in a Substack article.

projects.title: Prediction Uncertainty in Deep Image Synthesis
projects.description: Co-authored IEEE TVCG research investigating how neural networks express uncertainty in scientific image synthesis. My work examined pixel-level uncertainty, prediction error, and gradient sensitivity using MC-Dropout and Deep Ensembles, alongside an interactive visualization interface for exploring model behaviour.

projects.title: BorderPay
projects.description: A collaborative course project for managing employer–employee contracts and salary transactions on Hyperledger Fabric. It combines Go chaincode with Node.js/Express APIs and a React interface for user, contract, and payment workflows.

projects.title: Fraud Detection
projects.description: A machine-learning study of fraudulent transactions in an imbalanced dataset of over 1.8 million records. I explored preprocessing, feature selection, resampling, and comparisons between SVM, neural-network, and Random Forest classifiers, focusing on recall and evaluation under class imbalance.

projects.title: Computer Graphics Explorations
projects.description: A collection of five computer graphics assignments built with JavaScript and WebGL, exploring rendering through browser-based implementations.

projects.title: Image Processing Coursework
projects.description: Python and notebook implementations developed for IIT Kanpur’s image processing course, documenting practical work with image-processing algorithms and visual data.

projects.title: Territorial Attack
projects.description: A team game-development project from IIT Kanpur’s Game Development Society, built in Unity with C# gameplay scripts, character controls, combat mechanics, and game UI.

projects.title: Amazon Price Tracker
projects.description: A Python automation project that checks an Amazon product’s price and sends an email alert when it drops, combining HTML parsing, recurring checks, and SMTP notifications.

projects.title: Codeforces Stress Testing Platform
projects.description: A programming-club project using Go concurrency, web scraping, database integration, and automated grading to stress-test Codeforces submissions.

writing.title: Ronaldo’s Last Dance: I Built a World Cup Predictor to See If Portugal Can Actually Win
writing.description: The story behind my World Cup simulator: how team ratings, lineups, and 100,000 simulated tournaments turn a football question into a probability model, and where that model still falls short.
